{{Quote|The witch and the Jedi.''"<br />"''Here for our taking.|[[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]|<ref name="Revenge (episode)">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''skirmish above Raydonia''' was a short [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Raydonia/Legends|Raydonia]] that took place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I am surprised you could have forgotten me so easily after I killed your master and you left me for dead on Naboo!''"<br />"''It ''is'' you.''"<br />"''You may have forgotten me, but I will ''never'' forget you!|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Revenge (episode)" />}}
[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Eta-class shuttle/Legends|landed]] on Raydonia, to see horrid corpses and destroyed buildings, before seeing [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]&mdash;the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] whom Kenobi thought he had killed&mdash;in person. Remembering when they [[Battle of Naboo/Legends#Duel in Theed|dueled]], long ago, Kenobi activated his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], only to have [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]&mdash;Maul's brother&mdash;ambush him and deliver several punches and kicks against Kenobi, knocking him unconscious.

==The skirmish==
{{Quote|Your master, Qui-Gon Jinn. I ''gutted'' him while you stood helpless and watched. How did that make you ''feel'', Obi-Wan?|Darth Maul taunting Obi-Wan Kenobi aboard the [[Turtle Tanker/Legends|Turtle Tanker]]|<ref name="Revenge (episode)" />}}
Obi-Wan Kenobi was tortured by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] aboard their [[Turtle Tanker/Legends|ship]]. [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], meanwhile, snuck aboard their ship as it took off from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Raydonia/Legends|Raydonia]]. After the ship was airborne, Ventress revealed herself to the two brothers before disappearing, confusing them before they knocked Kenobi out cold and began searching for Ventress, leaving Kenobi in the cargo hold. Moments later, Ventress managed to wake up the unconscious Jedi and temporarily handed over one of [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|her lightsabers]] before the brothers returned, preparing to battle.

With one of [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|Ventress' lightsabers]], Kenobi managed to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to take [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]] from a furious [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], passing Ventress' lightsaber back to her, as he noticed that she was starting to lose from her battle with Savage Opress. Then, Maul and Obi-Wan climbed to a dark section of the cargo hold, and the two dueled furiously. Although Obi-Wan initially held the upper hand, Maul began to taunt Obi-Wan about [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] death, infuriating and unbalancing him, causing him to use [[Form IV/Legends|aggressive forms]] of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], but ended as Maul kicked Kenobi off the ramp. The duo switched places, with Kenobi battling [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] dueling with [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], ending with them retreating into the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] successfully, forcing Maul to use a [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] to close the door, leaving him and his brother alone.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|That was cutting it a little close.''"<br />"''You do know it's not over.''"<br />"''I know.''"<br />"''They'll be after us both now.|Asajj Ventress and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Revenge (episode)" />}}
Maul, after witnessing the escape of his foes, vowed that after having waited over a decade to get revenge against the Jedi, he could wait a little longer. Meanwhile, Ventress and Kenobi concluded that it was not over, and that Maul and Opress would be after both of them.
